Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
BeatO / LinX CGM
: 14- to 15-day wear sensors providing real-time Bluetooth tracking without manual scanning. Costs roughly ₹3,946 to ₹4,100.
shop.beatoapp.com
Abbott FreeStyle Libre 2/3 Plus
: Real-time minute-to-minute interstitial glucose tracking with optional high/low alarms. Prescription usually required.

Dexcom G7 / Stelo

Samsung Galaxy Watch Series (6, 7, 8)
: Features on-board sensors for blood pressure (BP) and medical-grade ECG tracking, priced around ₹11,000–₹16,000.

: Provides high-accuracy ECG tests and passive atrial fibrillation detection alongside advanced sleep apnea alerts.
